note: London is framed week on week and year on year rather than against target: the FY26/27 weekly targets were set before the Shard's traffic shift and the Dim Sum Library rebrand, so variance to them is not a clean read, and DSL is flagged not comparable for the same reason. London booked 3,055 GA4 bookings, down 3.5 percent week on week and down 6.0 percent year on year. The year-on-year gap is entirely Aqua Shard, which is 475 bookings below last year and more than the whole London shortfall on its own; the other five venues together are up 18.9 percent year on year. Week on week only Azzurra and Shiro Sushi grew. Aqua Shard, Hutong and DSL are all within a few percent of the restated W33, and Regent St is the softest at 10 percent below it. Conversion is still the healthier half of the picture: it is above last year at Regent St, Azzurra, Shiro Sushi and DSL, flat at Hutong, and down only at Aqua Shard, so outside the Shard this reads as a traffic problem rather than a booking-journey one. Covers are reported alongside these figures because total_payment is unreliable in London and GA4 cannot see OpenTable.
